skills.name: Brawler
skills.description:
Focus your strength into a mighty swing, dealing |cffffff2942|r Physical Damage to enemies in front of you.

You also gain a damage shield that absorbs |cffffff2826|r damage for |cffffff6|r seconds. Each enemy hit increases the damage shield's strength by |cffffff50|r%, up to |cffffff300|r%.

skills.name: Cephaliarch's Flail
skills.description:
Infuse your arm with abyssal magic to form tentacles that lash out at your foes dealing |cffffff3276|r Physical Damage and generating Crux. Enemies are immobilized for |cffffff3|r seconds and marked with Abyssal Ink for |cffffff20|r seconds.

If an enemy is hit, you for heal for |cffffff1394|r Health, once per cast.

You deal |cffffff5|r% increased damage to enemies drenched in Abyssal Ink.

skills.name: Pragmatic Fatecarver
skills.description:
Channel a beam of energy in front of you for up to |cffffff4|r seconds, dealing |cffffff1484|r Magic Damage every |cffffff0.3|r seconds to up to 6 enemies. While channeling, you also gain a damage shield that absorbs up to |cffffff4927|r damage and grants interrupt immunity.

Casting Pragmatic Fatecarver consumes all Crux and increases damage done by |cffffff33|r%, and decreases cost by |cffffff16|r% per Crux spent.

This ability is considered direct damage.

skills.name: Killer's Blade
skills.description:
Thrust a caustic blade with lethal precision to stab an enemy, dealing |cffffff1856|r Disease Damage. Deals up to |cffffff400|r% more damage to enemies with less than |cffffff50|r% Health.

Heals you for |cffffff3343|r if the enemy dies within |cffffff2|r seconds of being struck.

skills.name: Echoing Vigor
skills.description: Let loose a battle cry, instilling you and your allies with resolve and healing for |cffffff7281|r Health over |cffffff16|r seconds.

skills.name: Soul Harvest
skills.description:
Ravage an enemy with a spinning attack, dealing |cffffff5942|r Magic Damage and increasing your damage against them by |cffffff20|r% for |cffffff8|r seconds.

Also afflicts the enemy with Major Defile, reducing their healing received and damage shield strength by |cffffff12|r%.

While slotted on either bar, any time you kill an enemy you gain |cffffff10|r Ultimate.
